title: New Home Builder Warranties Held by One Customer on Several Homes
content:
**Rule.** A customer may own several warranted homes under Bridgewell's New Home Builder Warranties, each with its own warranty. Whether one home can carry more than one warranty is not settled by this rule; it is governed by the rule that a home is enrolled once and carries no second open warranty.

No maximum is set on the number of warranted homes one customer may hold.

## In practice

| Question | Answer under the rule |
|---|---|
| May one customer hold New Home Builder Warranties on two or more homes? | Yes; each home has its own warranty. |
| Is there a cap on how many such homes one customer may hold? | No maximum is set. |
| Does one warranty cover several homes of the same customer? | No; each home's warranty is its own. |

**Hypothetical illustration.** A customer owns three newly built homes at three different addresses, each enrolled by its builder. The customer holds three separate New Home Builder Warranties, one per home, each running on its own dates and its own records.
